subject: Future Tech
title: Lunar Launch Pad
description: A 60-second lesson on Lunar Launch Pad.

hook.text: Launching from the Moon takes 22 times less energy than from Earth. Its weak gravity makes it a perfect waypoint.

buildup.text: A lunar base could refine fuel from ice and load ships heading to Mars, asteroids, or beyond at a fraction of the cost.

discovery.text: Electromagnetic rail launchers could fling cargo off the Moon without rockets at all, using solar-powered magnets.

twist.text: Building permanent infrastructure on the Moon requires sustained funding that no single nation has committed to yet.

climax.text: If the Moon becomes a fuel depot and launch pad, deep space missions become routine rather than heroic one-offs.

punchline.text: The Moon is the best gas station on the way out.

quiz.question: Why is launching from the Moon much cheaper energy-wise?
